briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF L-002
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- warehouse roof: (-77, 130), roof
- water tower top: (13, 29), roof
- pump house: (121, 48), indoor
- control room: (-128, -109), indoor
- electrical room: (114, -7), indoor
- loading dock: (-60, 99), outdoor
- fuel depot: (-27, -36), outdoor
- east fence: (73, 45), outdoor
- transformer pad: (-6, -64), outdoor
- gate 2: (-36, 14), outdoor

Robots:
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 5 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 3600 s, including the return to its start.
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 960 s, including the return to its start.
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1320 s, including the return to its start.
- G1 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 16 kg), camera. Endurance: 4920 s, including the return to its start.
- M2 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 9 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2820 s, including the return to its start.
- M3 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 9 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 3540 s, including the return to its start.
- D3 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1140 s, including the return to its start.
- D4 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1140 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Deliver the sensor box (8 kg) to electrical room. Location: electrical room. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 8 kg).
- T2: Run a thermal scan of water tower top. Location: water tower top. Duration: 120 s. Needs: thermal camera.
- T3: Deliver the cable reel (9 kg) to electrical room. Location: electrical room. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 9 kg).
- T4: Photograph gate 2 for the condition report. Location: gate 2. Duration: 90 s. Needs: camera.
- T5: Deliver the replacement filter (4 kg) to loading dock. Location: loading dock. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 4 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 480 s.
- T6: Deliver the battery pack (10 kg) to pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 10 kg).
- T7: Deliver the pressure gauge (14 kg) to east fence. Location: east fence. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 14 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 240 s.
- T8: Collect a soil sample (2 kg) at transformer pad and keep it on board. Location: transformer pad. Duration: 90 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 2 kg).
- T9: Deliver the sensor box (12 kg) to control room. Location: control room. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 12 kg).
- T10: Run a thermal scan of transformer pad. Location: transformer pad. Duration: 150 s. Needs: thermal camera.
- T11: Photograph fuel depot for the condition report. Location: fuel depot. Duration: 150 s. Needs: camera.
- T12: Tighten the valve at east fence. Location: east fence. Duration: 270 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T13: Inspect water tower top with a camera. Location: water tower top. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera.
- T14: Deliver the replacement filter (6 kg) to gate 2. Location: gate 2. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 6 kg).
- T15: Replace the filter cartridge at electrical room. Location: electrical room. Duration: 240 s. Needs: robotic arm. Can start only after T1 is finished.
- T16: Deliver the spare pump (4 kg) to pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 4 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 540 s.

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Keep at least 1 quadcopter on standby: it must not be given any task.
6. Every task must be finished by t = 1200 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Hi team, here is today's job at the site.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: warehouse roof (-77, 130, a rooftop); water tower top (13, 29, a rooftop); pump house (121, 48, indoors); control room (-128, -109, indoors); electrical room (114, -7, indoors); loading dock (-60, 99, outside); fuel depot (-27, -36, outside); east fence (73, 45, outside); transformer pad (-6, -64, outside); gate 2 (-36, 14, outside).

The fleet: M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 5 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 60 minutes including getting back. D1 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 7.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 16 minutes including the flight home. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 8.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 22 minutes including the flight home. G1 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 16 kg at 1.5 m/s and runs for 82 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. M2 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 9 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 47 minutes including getting back. M3 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 9 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 59 minutes including getting back. D3 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 7.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 19 minutes including the flight home. D4, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera and a thermal camera, cruises at 8 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 19 minutes of flight time, return trip included.

Jobs:
(T1) Get the sensor box (8 kg) over to electrical room - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T2) Look for overheating equipment around water tower top - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T3) Electrical room needs the cable reel, which weighs 9 kg - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T4) We need pictures of gate 2 for the report - that takes 1.5 minutes on site.
(T5) Loading dock needs the replacement filter, which weighs 4 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 8 minutes.
(T6) Get the battery pack (10 kg) over to pump house - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T7) Drop the pressure gauge off at east fence; it weighs 14 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 4 minutes.
(T8) Pick up a soil sample at transformer pad and keep it on board; it weighs 2 kg - that takes 1.5 minutes on site.
(T9) Drop the sensor box off at control room; it weighs 12 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T10) Look for overheating equipment around transformer pad - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T11) We need pictures of fuel depot for the report - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T12) The valve at east fence needs tightening - that takes 4.5 minutes on site.
(T13) Do a visual check of water tower top - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T14) Drop the replacement filter off at gate 2; it weighs 6 kg - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T15) Swap the filter cartridge at electrical room - that takes 4 minutes on site but only once the sensor box (T1) has arrived.
(T16) Pump house needs the spare pump, which weighs 4 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 9 minutes.

Keep one quadcopter on standby; don't give it any jobs. Everything has to be wrapped up within 20 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
